47: ## Separately ownable roles and two-hour vertical slices
48: 
49: | Role | Exclusive responsibility | First bounded slice and dependencies |
50: |---|---|---|
51: | Rust domain/storage contract owner | Shared domain ports, lane/privacy assignments, migration contract, native SurrealDB adapter contract; no shell UI | Freeze a synthetic patient/case/conversation read contract and authoritative-write boundary. Explicitly reconcile requested SurrealDB 3.3.0 against inherited SQLite, verify exact crate features, and define identity-scoped lifecycle. Other roles consume this contract. |
52: | Forge/Fabric data integration owner | Server ASO projection, RLS, shape scope, state/cursor atomicity, recovery semantics | After contract freeze, expose one authorized synthetic conversation/case read from real Postgres through the selected host/Fabric path. Carry PGlite adoption block visibly; no clinical authority migration to a projection store. |
53: | Identity/gateway owner | Kratos browser/native credentials, Flint Gate/Cedar policy, Envoy adapter and trusted header contract | After session/principal contract freeze, wire one actual browser session and one native credential path to the same scoped read. Settle the missing ext_authz implementation or use the supported proxy path explicitly. No implicit authority inherited by agents. |
54: | Shared React web/Tauri owner | One React feature implementation, hooks and entity joins; transport injection only per shell | After read/session contracts, display the same case and conversation in both shells; adapt PGlite versus Rust-hosted storage under shared hooks. Do not fork React business logic by platform. |
55: | Monorepo release/docs owner | Root build/deploy/docs workflow paths, build coordinator, local stack recipe and evidence inventory | Establish actual package commands and one build writer. Web build each iteration, full web/Tauri build every other iteration. CI build/lint/typecheck/package only. No deployment implied by team creation. |
56: | Integration verifier, dormant until phase boundary | Completed-phase production-path evidence and independent artifact critique | Activate after the coherent slice is complete. Run local stack through actual UI, host, identity, storage and collaborators: same scoped record, denied wrong principal, logout/scope teardown, native reopen. Tests only at completed full-phase boundary; per-iteration builds are not tests or runtime acceptance. |
57: 
58: Suggested dependency chain: shared contract + session tuple → authorized server read and native adapter in parallel → one shared React feature → local web build each iteration and full web/Tauri every other → completed-phase local integration gate. Two hours is a scheduling window, not permission to reduce the phase exit criteria. If upstream version/auth work consumes it, report Blocked or Build-only with the exact missing dependency rather than replacing the production path with mocks.
